resampling: One Lanczos reduction of smooth RGBA artwork, followed by binary-alpha silhouette cleanup. No source pixel grid is requested.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: smooth illustrated JRPG civilian character cutout for a game.
Create a polished hand-drawn cartoon illustration with smooth continuous curves, clean dark warm-brown ink contours and broad cel-shaded color shapes. Gentle upper-left light and restrained cool shadows give the clothes volume. Smooth edges and softly blended transitions within large material forms are welcome. Absolutely no pixel art, pixelation, visible square blocks, stair-step outlines, mosaic texture, dithering, crosshatching, grain, distressed texture or individual strand detail. Do not simulate a low-resolution image.
One complete full-body character in a compact Japanese RPG style, balanced miniature adult proportions, approximately three heads tall, head including hair/cap one third of total height; torso and legs each another third, slight overhead view, facing forward, relaxed standing pose. A large expressive head, two clearly separated dark eyes with small white sclera shapes, a simple nose and mouth; readable facial features with broad shapes. Costume seams and fingers are simplified, never tiny decorative marks. Broad connected hands and feet.
Requested canvas 1280 x 1280, truly transparent background. Complete silhouette about 80 percent of canvas height, centered horizontally, generous clear margins on all sides. Boots fully visible. No scenery, floor, ground plane, shadow outside the body, text, labels, border, UI, diagram, alternate views, turnaround, or extra figures. This is smooth source artwork, not an enlarged sprite. Design to remain legible when reduced for a small game actor.
Reference image Bram: use ONLY his head-to-body ratio, standing stance and compact proportions. Discard his pixelated rendering. The output must have entirely smooth illustrated curves and shading. Avoid the enormous half-body head of a toy or toddler.
